craft_notes: Sthāyin: eightfold machinery — the catalogue that does the work. Sanskrit-first: aṣṭadhā + the eight-form list kept item-wise; tādātmyena ca (by-identity-too) kept the hinge; etīti/uktaṃ kept the verdict-voice; fruit-list kept all eight (each fruit a claim, none trimmed). Rows: 9 (eight forms + eight fruits — double catalogue), 2 (long compound lists unpacked down the line-break), 1 (‘assuming that and that form’ closes — tattadrūpa end-weight), 12 declined — the catalogue's roll is the energy, not settle. Close: 'assuming that and that form.' Rejected: trimming the fruit-list to four — killed: eight are the claim (firmness-to-nondifference); resolving 'śrīmadānandādau' — killed: held as glossed, noted in L3 (person-or-joy locus unresolved); 'deities' for forms — killed: mūrti kept forms. Read aloud: AND-EIGHT-fold: IN-earth-, WA-ter-, WIND-, FIRE-, SKY-, MOON-, SUN-, AND-self-FORMED-places … CHIEF-fruits, HERE-and-THERE, FROM-the-MAN-tra PLACED-in-EACH, AS-SUM-ing THAT-and-THAT-form.

lines: And eightfold: in earth-, water-, wind-, fire-, sky-,
moon-, sun-, and self-formed places — the eight forms
made into Supreme-Lord forms by mantra-placement's majesty;
by identity, in the body entered by the Supreme, for anyone,
immersion in the Supreme arises — though from gladness
of bathing-clothes and the rest it becomes the means: thus told.
As in revered Ānanda and the rest: firmness, nourishment, vigor,
chief fruits, here and there, from the mantra placed in each,
l4.sanskrit_cite: sa ca aṣṭadhā kṣitijalapavanahutāśanākāśasomasūryātmarūpāsu aṣṭāsu mūrtiṣu mantranyāsamahimnā parameśvararūpatayā bhāvitāsu tādātmyena ca dehe parameśvarasamāviṣṭe śarīrādivibhāgavṛtteḥ caitanyasyāpi parameśvarasamāveśaprāptiḥ kasyāpi tu snānavastrādituṣṭijanakatvāt parameśopāyatām etīti uktaṃ ca śrīmadānandādau dhṛtiḥ āpyāyo vīryaṃ maladāho vyāptiḥ sṛṣṭisāmarthyaṃ sthitisāmarthyam abhedaś ca ity etāni teṣu mukhyaphalāni teṣu teṣu upāhitasya mantrasya tattadrūpadhāritvāt
notes: 'śrīmadānandādau' held as glossed (person-or-joy locus unresolved; L0 clean)

reads_against.argmap: What is the eightfold bath, and what does it yield? → The eight mūrti-baths work by tādātmya in the Lord-entered body; their gladness itself becomes upāyātā; the mantra's assumed each-form yields the eight chief fruits.
c1_essence: Eight forms made into Supreme-Lord forms by mantra-placement: identity in the Lord-entered body brings immersion for anyone; bathing-gladness itself becomes the means; chief fruits — firmness to non-difference — follow each assumed form.
reads_against.c1_rasa: śānta with vidhi weight (quiescence carrying ritual order)
